title: Daily Routine
ques: What is the first good habit you should do every morning when you wake up to keep your teeth clean and strong?

answer.content: The first good habit is to **brush your teeth**.

explanation: This reinforces a fundamental daily hygiene practice.

title: Good Manners
ques: If you accidentally bump into someone in the hallway, what are the 'magic words' you should say?

answer.content: You should say, **'I am sorry'** or **'Excuse me'**.

explanation: This teaches basic social etiquette and polite behavior.

title: Health and Cleanliness
ques: Why should you cover your mouth when you sneeze or cough?

answer.content: You should cover your mouth so that you do not spread your germs to other people and make them sick.

explanation: This explains the reasoning behind a critical health habit, encouraging mindful behavior.
